description: This is a Java test class for the AnySoftKeyboard project, specifically testing the persistent layout behavior across different input sessions, configuration changes, and service restarts.

classes.name: AnySoftKeyboardKeyboardPersistentLayoutTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing persistent keyboard layout behavior in AnySoftKeyboard.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, sets configuration, and starts the keyboard service.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Cleanup after tests (empty in this case).

methods.name: startInputFromPackage
methods.description: Simulates starting input with a specific package ID, optionally with restart and configuration change flags.

methods.name: startInputFromPackage
methods.description: Overloaded method to start input without restart or config change.

methods.name: finishInput
methods.description: Simulates finishing the current input session.

methods.name: testSwitchLayouts
methods.description: Tests switching between different keyboard layouts using key codes.

methods.name: testLayoutPersistentWithPackageId
methods.description: Verifies that the keyboard layout persists per package ID across input sessions.

methods.name: testLayoutPersistentWithPackageIdOnConfigurationChanged
methods.description: Checks persistence of layout after configuration changes like orientation change.

methods.name: testLayoutResetPersistentWithPackageIdWhenLayoutDisabled
methods.description: Ensures layout resets when the keyboard layout is disabled.

methods.name: testLayoutNotPersistentWithPackageIdIfPrefIsDisabled
methods.description: Verifies that persistence is disabled if the user preference is turned off.

methods.name: testPersistentLastLayoutAcrossServiceRestarts
methods.description: Checks that the last used layout persists across service restarts.

methods.name: testDoesNotPersistentLastLayoutAcrossServiceRestartsWhenSettingIsDisabled
methods.description: Verifies that persistence does not occur when the setting is disabled.
